(3) SAM as a refiner of pool picks (exp104: bbox of the picked mask as the prompt) does not help (0.459-0.476; hybrid +0.005..+0.017, below the 262-row noise SE ~0.022). Therefore the gIoU gap is localizer BOX quality alone; no mask-side mechanism (pool or SAM) closes it in this environment.

precision_clip_probe.question: 41% of predicted mass is outside GT (I/S_U = 0.5869); clip the union to its source boxes?

standard_change_2026_10_08.what_changed: Operator standard change (user instruction, 2026-10-08): the gRefCOCO comparison is now same-methodology (zero-shot). The floor is the best published number from the same method class, not the fully-supervised state of the art. Fully-supervised rows (InstAlign, GSVA(ft), ReLA, SAM4MLLM, LAVT) remain in the table as labelled reference rows and are never floors. A small component may be trained on the gRefCOCO train split, tuned on a held-out split carved from train; official val/test remain evaluation-only. InstAlign's code is not released (github.com/nero1342/InstAlign is a placeholder); it is not chased.

gIoU.source: PSALM ECCV 2024: gRefCOCO val cIoU 42.0 / gIoU 43.3 (zero-shot)

same_class_floors.escalation_rule: per-metric best same-class number; PSALM 42.0/43.3 was the operator-named floor, SELF1E-8B 44.4 (CVPR 2026) is higher on cIoU, so the cIoU floor is raised to 44.4 and beaten

standard_change_2026_10_08.trained_vs_frozen: All base components frozen off the shelf: released HybridGL scorer, LLaVA-OneVision-7B box prior, GroundingDINO-base, SAM ViT-H, CLIP ViT-B/16, yes/no existence probes. The only fitted quantities are the gRefCOCO selector's configuration and thresholds (four 300-trial Optuna studies, exp/out_final/optuna_study.json), fitted on held-out rows carved from the gRefCOCO TRAIN split (records_grefcoco_train_tune.jsonl) and frozen before the single full-val pass (exp124).
